The 'next' action clamps offset to min(offset+limit, user_count), so from page 2 offset becomes user_count (100), producing currentPage=3=totalPages — a blank page displayed as the last page, and the real last page's data boundary is off. Math is directly inspectable in admin-group.js.es6 and group.js.

judged_text: Pagination math wrong at boundaries: totalPages = floor(user_count/limit)+1 adds an extra empty page when user_count % limit == 0, and next clamps offset to min(offset+limit, user_count) instead of (totalPages-1)*limit, causing unreachable/looping blank pages

record.issue_text: Pagination math wrong at boundaries: totalPages = floor(user_count/limit)+1 adds an extra empty page when user_count % limit == 0, and next clamps offset to min(offset+limit, user_count) instead of (totalPages-1)*limit, causing unreachable/looping blank pages

adjudication.rationale: In `admin-group.js.es6`, `totalPages` is computed as `Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1` (when `user_count>0`), which yields an extra page when `user_count` is an exact multiple of `limit` (e.g. 50/50 => 2 instead of 1). Additionally, `next` clamps `offset` to `Math.min(offset + limit, user_count)`, which can set `offset == user_count` (e.g. 50), and `Group.findMembers` then requests `offset: 50` (allowed by its `min(user_count, ...)`), producing an empty members list from `GroupsController#members` (`limit(...).offset(50)` on total 50). This matches the finding: a blank/extra page at boundaries.
